question: How is the deity of cognitive greatness manifested and unfolded?
premises: By the surge of sovereign power, the lordly state is obtained.
The deity whose greatness is cognition becomes manifested.
This manifestation is unfolded as the present teaching.
inference: Therefore the deity's unfolded form is the manifestation of sovereign cognitive power.
plain_english: By the surge of sovereign power, this deity, whose greatness is cognition and who has obtained the name of the lordly state, has become manifested and unfolded.
